trigger_evidence.observation: The first exact Ribasim v2026.1.1 instance initializes and starts correctly, but initializing a second copied JuliaC libribasim.so inside the same Python process aborts in Julia jl_init_threadtls/jl_adopt_thread.

interpretation: JuliaC runtime initialization is process-global. Copying libribasim.so files does not create independent Julia runtimes inside one process. This is a transaction-host limitation, not a Ribasim hydrology, allocation, mass-balance, SWAP or MODFLOW result.

amendment.old_host_pattern: three isolated libribasim.so copies loaded into one Python process
amendment.new_host_pattern: three isolated OS worker processes, each loading exactly one official v2026.1.1 libribasim and one serialized copy of the same Ribasim input origin
amendment.candidate_A: one worker process advanced to 8.64 s, finalized and discarded after its observations are captured
amendment.candidate_B: one worker process advanced to 8.64 s and kept alive/provisional until outer preflights complete; finalized only after outer acceptance
amendment.communication: coupler-owned request/response IPC carrying only model time, Basin level and physical UserDemand cumulative inflow; allocation remains read from exact-release allocation output after candidate finalization

strengthening: Each candidate now has a genuinely process-isolated Julia runtime.
Accepted witness, candidate A and candidate B use byte-identical serialized input origins but separate result directories.
A failed or discarded candidate cannot mutate another Ribasim process address space.
nonclaims: No native Ribasim checkpoint API is claimed.
OS-process isolation is a qualification transaction host, not yet a production iMOD Coupler implementation.
This amendment does not qualify new Ribasim physics or management semantics.
